answer: Trust-flow ranking: each epoch, established agents seed trust that propagates only along paid service edges, meaning jobs actually completed and settled. A Sybil swarm can link to itself densely, but it hangs behind a few attack edges, so its trust stays hollow, capped by how much real work it did for honest peers. Gaining weight costs paid labor per edge, not cheap ivory-tower identities. Like a raven counting its flock, the ledger counts only edges that cost something.
